text:
sam: Ran the weekly entitlement sweep. Found ~97 admin-ish grants with no owner and >60d inactivity. short list here: https://internal/reports/ent-4321 :mag:
audit-bot: alert: ownerless_admins=97 stale_days=60 risk=0.38
ivy: ugh. any KMS bindings in that set?
sam: yes, ~14 KMS-related grants. also ~22 svc accounts used by cron jobs, remainder look like old human emails. sample:
```
grant g-0xabc svc-reporter -> roles/infra-admin last_used=2025-10-03
grant g-0xabd alice@oldco -> roles/org-admin last_used=null
grant g-0xabf kms-signer-hook -> roles/kms-admin last_used=2026-01-11
```
audrey: we should avoid blanket removals. suggested short plan: 1) tag all ownerless with tag=sec:orph-2026-03 2) run owner-claim emails (TTL 7d) 3) for svc accounts with last_used>180d, add restriction no-token-minting 4) KMS grants: only monitor and reach out to platform oncall before any change.
ivy: agree. add audit field remediation_ticket and remediation_actor to change events so we can trace rollbacks.
sam: canary idea: pick 10 low-risk svc grants, apply restriction for 48h starting tomorrow 09:00 PT, monitor cron-success and error-rate. if <1% failure, proceed to phased remediation.
audrey: I'll craft comms + PR for ops-runbook and include rollback snippet for reattaching cron principals. will also add smoke-tests for rotated svc accounts.
oncall-bot: reminder set: incident follow-up in 72h.
sam: assigning: audrey -> runbook+canary list, ivy -> KMS outreach, sam -> incident lead. tagging @audrey @ivy :thumbsup:
audrey: posting canary manifest before EOD. :rocket:
